hypotheses.justification: CartesianMonoidalCategory already supplies a HasFiniteProducts instance (Cartesian/Basic.lean), and hasLimitsOfShape_discrete supplies HasBinaryProducts because WalkingPair is finite. Thus `omit [HasBinaryProducts K] in` leaves the statement elaborating and the existing proof valid. HasBinaryProducts is Prop-valued, so proof irrelevance preserves the chosen-product expressions. No additional nonemptiness or nontriviality assumption is needed.
